title: 健康・体力づくり
subtitle: Introduction to Fitness and Health Promotion
courseType: Student and Study Skills Courses ProgramCharacter Building CoursesLifelong Sports
teachers:
CADZOW Philip
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
To lead a healthy and fulfilling life throughout their own lifetime, students will learn the following:
(1) Knowledge about fitness and health promotion and lifestyle-related diseases, (2) Procedures for measuring and analyzing personal health and physical fitness characteristics, (3) How to develop a personal exercise prescription (training program), (4) How to understand and practice health and fitness self-care, (5) Various risks in student/social life, and (6) How to cooperate, lead, and observe rules
advice:
Students will learn knowledge and procedures for health promotion through measurement and diagnosis in health and physical fitness, the development of safe and effective individual exercise prescription/training programs, lifestyle-related diseases, and health care procedures. Specifically, students will learn the following: 1.Methods for warm-up exercises, 2.Measurement and diagnosis procedures in physical fitness, 3.Methods for strength, endurance, and shape-up training, 4.Exercise prescription procedures, 5.Knowledge about lifestyle-related diseases and health care procedures, 6.Self-management of diet, sleeping, and exercise habits for health promotion, and 7.Risks in student/social life.
 Classes will be held once per week (100 minutes).
In practical classes, students should wear appropriate clothing such as sportswear, T-shirts, shorts, and indoor shoes.
 Students should aim to attend all classes highly motivated to learn.
 Students should pay attention to their own health condition.
 Students should understand the knowledge and procedures necessary for health promotion, and practice them in student life and throughout their lifetime.
 Practice classes will take place in the gymnasium (Building 13 or Building 20), and lectures will take place in the lecture hall shown on the class schedule.
requiredKnowledge:
Taking an interest in various types of news and information about health and physical fitness.
Preparing for physical activities and understanding safety management in sports activities.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the procedures of exercise prescription and design effective training programs.
Be able to understand express the importance of health promotion throughout their lifetime.
Be able to understand and practice fundamental social skills such as cooperation and leadership.
Be able to understand the importance of self-management of lifestyle habits and to lead a healthy life.
Be able to study actively while paying careful attention to one's own health and fitness characteristics.
Be able to understand various health-related problems and explain these coping behaviors.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Fully understand the concepts and protocols of exercise prescription and assessment in physical fitness.(2) Fully understand various training methods, and design a safe and effective personal exercise prescription based on one's own goals and physical condition.(3) Fully understand the importance of managing one's own health and fitness condition throughout their lifetime, and explain their own views of it.(4) Understand effective warm-up protocols and carry them out with tremendous leadership or cooperation.(5) Understand the importance of the continuous health promotion throughout one's life, and apply it to daily life.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Understand the concepts and protocols of exercise prescription and assessment in physical fitness.(2) Understand the points of various training methods, and roughly design a safe and effective personal exercise prescription based on one's own goals and physical condition.(3) Understand the importance of managing one's own health and fitness condition throughout their lifetime, and explain their own views of it.(4) Understand effective warm-up protocols and carry them out with leadership and cooperation.(5) Understand the importance of continuous health promotion throughout one's life, and roughly apply it to daily life.
